name: Precautions on reports and opinions
what: You set a precaution on a report or on a classifier's opinion. It can alert you, take a checkpoint, pause the computer, take back a secret, close a network or another channel, and deny or hold a request still waiting; it never allows, resumes or stops a computer. It says what it rests on, the app shows it as not exact, and by default the computer sees nothing of it.
